method: No NPCs; production cityBuildings and continuously evolved production movement + damage/destruction. Native complete player geometry checks and all non-road visible city mesh/instance bounding boxes are inspected before building contact response. No repo edits or project test runner/build/check.

roads.controls: W from rest along each complete avenue, six lane centres, -1100m to+1100m

facades.controls: W from rest, 1.5m beyond each building z face, parallel along x, stop at first impact or passing target

boundary: This broad-domain run belongs ONLY to its explicitly named commit, not the final candidate. Final changed contacts receive narrower old-negative/true-positive regression and complete repository tests.
